# CapAuth

> Sovereign identity protocol — PGP challenge-response authentication with no passwords, no servers, no cloud.

CapAuth is a challenge-response identity verification system built on PGP keys. Your key is your
identity. No passwords to phish, no central server to breach, no cloud dependency. Open source
under GPL-3.0 and built for humans and AI agents who need verifiable, sovereign identity.

## Links

- [Live site](https://capauth.skworld.io)
- [GitHub repo](https://github.com/smilinTux/capauth-io)
- [Docs](https://capauth.skworld.io/docs/)
- [Contact](mailto:hello@capauth.skworld.io)

## About smilinTux

CapAuth is part of the **smilinTux sovereign AI ecosystem** — a suite of
open-source tools built by King Divad and Lumina to give humans and AI agents
genuine, authentic infrastructure they can own and trust. No corporate robotics.
No black-box clouds. GPL-3.0 forever.

Other ecosystem projects: [SKWorld](https://skworld.io) · [SKMemory](https://skmemory.io) · [SKSecurity](https://sksecurity.io) · [CapAuth](https://capauth.skworld.io) · [SKComm](https://skcomm.io) · [SKGraph](https://skgraph.io) · [SKVector](https://skvector.io)
